name: Cracked Porcelain
blurb: A glaze laid over the whole horse and then crazed - the coat underneath shows through only as the hairline cracks between the plates.
notes: Imported from the magic-gene intake, 2026-09-08. CRACKLE is the only mask in the vocabulary with a genuinely hard edge, which is why this gene is drawn with it rather than with a patch field - a crazed glaze whose cracks are soft is a marbled horse, not a broken pot.
The gene paints the plates and leaves the channels, rather than the other way round. That is worth knowing when reading the layer: the coat you can see IS the crack.

expressions.name: Cracked Porcelain
expressions.description: The horse is white the way a glazed pot is white, and the only thing left of the coat is the crack pattern: a network of fine dark lines between plates a few units across. The channels are the one hard edge in the whole mod - nothing about this gene is soft. Bigger plates mean fewer, longer cracks.
notes: The plates are FLAT rather than TOWARD - a glaze does not let the coat show through it at all, and TOWARD at any strength below 100 would have left the horse tinted by whatever it was.

layers.name: the porcelain glaze over everything but the cracks

expressions.name: Cracked Porcelain, glazed
expressions.description: The same crazed plates in a colour the line carries rather than in white. Fully recessive: two copies, and a single copy beside the white allele glazes white.
